summary: Anfield Energy filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 10, 2026 press release on operational milestones at its Velvet-Wood uranium-vanadium project in Utah, not a special situation. The company disclosed Concept Approval from the Utah Division of Water Quality for its water treatment plan and a formal request to reactivate Outfall under the existing UPDES Permit. Subject to approval and compliance, treated-water discharge is targeted for the second week of November, clearing the path to active dewatering; decline dewatering is estimated at one month and workings at two to three months. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated; risk-arb angle is nil.
